content.rendered:
Retake day is Wednesday, November 13th. If we did not see you on picture day or you would like a new image, do not miss out on ordering pictures for your student. If you previously ordered a picture package and will be participating in the retakes, please send your package with your student to be returned to the photographer.

Orders may be placed online by searching for Sherwood Charter School at mydorian.com and selecting the green Order button next to the retake day event. Online orders are available up to 2 days after retake day.

Students getting their picture taken may wear uniform or nicer on retake day.
